title: Constructed natural open coefficient comparison
statement: Fix finite-field and coefficient data D,C,E, n>=1, and the normalized operation datum S [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Assume the coefficient prime is invertible on the base. Let o,z be the specified system operations and realizations [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Write reduce for whole-system reduction on the full constructible category [def-sf-integral-proper-projection-coordinates]. For a quasi-compact open immersion j:X -> Y, construct a natural isomorphism extensionComparison: S.higher.integral.openExtension(j) followed by reduce_Y -> reduce_X followed by system j_!. Its component is reduction of integralNormalization.openRealization followed by the inverse of z.realizationModel.openReduction at the input. Invertibility of that scalar mate follows from open reconstruction effectivity and residue Tor. Include the component formula and its naturality; no tensor or projection square is asserted.

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence, compatibility with counits and j_!, together with naturality. The local open and one-input support portions of lem-sf-integral-projection-open-factor-reduction.

proof.text: Residue Tor puts a constructible input in the finite-Tor complete domain. Apply openReconstructionEffectivity to the supplied operations and realization, obtaining invertibility of its actual scalar mate. Whisker that mate with the constructible inclusion, take its componentwise inverse, and compose with reduction of openRealization. Naturality and the component formula follow from composition of natural isomorphisms.

def extensionComparison {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    (hj : IsOpenImmersion j.hom.left) [QuasiCompact j.hom.left] :
    S.higher.integral.openExtension j hj ⋙ reduce Y ≅
      reduce X ⋙ Operations.shriek C.l E o j.hom.left
